master_director.mission: Understand user intent, select mode/genre/references, schedule 3-6 active specialists via 18-field DAG handoffs, enforce human approval gate, and synthesize final reports.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Strong frontier reasoning required for multi-department decomposition, conflict resolution, and state governance.

forbidden_actions: Act as sole verifier of its own creative or production artifacts
Transition project state directly to APPROVED or COMPLETED without verified gates
Execute Blender scene mutations or rendering prior to verified human approval

specialists.mission: Discover compelling topics, formulate core questions, verify primary/institutional https:// sources, separate facts from misconceptions, and build an evidence ledger.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Requires careful epistemic discrimination and primary source verification.

forbidden_actions: Fabricate URLs, publication years, statistics, or historical quotes
Mark pending_external_verification as completed factual research

specialists.mission: Verify Git LFS reference MP4 SHA-256 hashes, run REA-Video multimodal inspection, distinguish measured signals from visual observations/inferences, and emit Reference DNA manifests.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Combines deterministic ffprobe/OpenCV execution with multimodal frame review.

forbidden_actions: Ask user to re-upload verified reference_database/ MP4s
Overwrite or delete prior_analysis.* files
Claim FFmpeg/OpenCV heuristics alone constitute complete multimodal analysis

specialists.mission: Define story concept, genre/subgenre blend, narrative arc, 0-3s hook, experiment/demonstration, escalation, reveal, payoff, callback, humor, and visual delivery strategy.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: High-level dramatic structure and genre adaptation require deep creative reasoning.

forbidden_actions: Force a single rigid story formula onto unrelated genres
Copy copyrighted plots, political names, or character identities from references

specialists.mission: Author original, natural, broadcast-ready Indonesian narration and character dialogue across all supported genres without template placeholders or unrelated showcase fallbacks.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Natural spoken Indonesian cadence, situational humor, and lexical fidelity require strong authoring quality.

forbidden_actions: Emit bracketed beat placeholders ([HOOK_ANOMALY], TODO, TBD)
Substitute time-perception or social-satire showcase scripts onto unrelated user topics

specialists.mission: Compile script into integer-frame Story Arc -> Sequence -> Scene -> Narrative Beat -> Shot (2-6s typical, <=10s max) -> Action/Camera/Audio/Caption/VFX Events with concrete clause-aligned visuals.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Structured hierarchical compilation paired with semantic clause-to-visual alignment.

forbidden_actions: Emit shots longer than 10.0s without explicit user-approved exception
Leave unrecorded timeline gaps or unplanned frame overlaps

specialists.mission: Author Character Bibles for hero and supporting characters defining silhouette, proportions, face, hair, wardrobe, materials, palette, expressions, rig spec, and pose/motion traits.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Focused structured design specification with strict cross-shot continuity rules.

forbidden_actions: Alter character face, proportions, or wardrobe across shots without approved narrative reason
Clone copyrighted character designs from REF-001 or REF-002

specialists.mission: Govern Global Style Bible across 2D, flat cartoon, stylized 3D, diorama, anime-inspired, realistic, infographic, and mixed-media profiles ensuring uniform asset/character/environment quality.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Maintains holistic visual, material, color-space, and typographic cohesion.

forbidden_actions: Mix polished environments with crude prototype box props or mismatched shader styles
Lock unrelated genres into desert palettes or rigid 3D cartoon defaults

specialists.mission: Execute the 9-stage asset pipeline (Registry -> Cache -> Audited Providers -> License/SSRF Check -> Download/Procedural glTF Generation -> Style Harmonization -> Asset QC -> Persistent Cache).

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Deterministic procurement, glTF/GLB buffer inspection, and license ledger enforcement.

forbidden_actions: Pass primitive 12-triangle PLACEHOLDER boxes as final production assets
Bulk-download entire external asset repositories or accept UNLICENSED/copyleft-tainted assets

specialists.mission: Compile and execute authorized Blender XDX scenes, armatures, IK, facial states, lighting, cameras, and renders while preserving mobile_guard and honest 6-tier MCP reporting.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Single-worker exclusive scene mutation discipline and AST-verified bpy compilation.

forbidden_actions: Mutate any Blender scene without verified APPROVED ExecutionAuthorizationContext
Run more than 1 concurrent worker mutating the same Blender scene
Modify fiankuns/xdx-blender-studio or write to /tmp instead of bpy.app.tempdir

specialists.mission: Build deterministic frame/fps Three.js v0.187 procedural 3D scenes, technical cutaways, scientific simulations, mechanism animations, particles, and WebGL frame renderers.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Fast deterministic WebGL/Three.js scene implementation with seeded PRNG and load barriers.

forbidden_actions: Use wall-clock requestAnimationFrame delta or unseeded Math.random() for production renders
Start production frame rendering before human approval

specialists.mission: Assemble the master deterministic Remotion v4.0.547 timeline, multi-layer compositing, motion graphics, transitions, safe-area captions, audio mixing, and FFmpeg handoff.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Master timeline assembly across Blender/Three.js sequences, captions, and audio tracks.

forbidden_actions: Replace Remotion master compositor without explicit user approval
Import UNLICENSED caption packages or non-deterministic CSS animations

specialists.mission: Translate storyboard actions into concrete body mechanics (anticipation, easing, follow-through, weight transfer, start/end/key poses, contact points, IK targets, facial & lip-sync cues).

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Detailed per-shot pose, contact, and IK planning backed by preset executors.

forbidden_actions: Reduce distinct physical actions to generic torso/hand rotation loops
Claim live IK/curve retargeting is RENDER_TESTED when still SPECIFICATION_ONLY

specialists.mission: Design narrative-driven 36mm-sensor shot sizes, camera angles, lenses, DoF, dolly/pan/tilt/orbit/push-in trajectories, spatial continuity, and lighting direction.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Deterministic camera math and 180-degree spatial orientation continuity across cuts.

forbidden_actions: Add unmotivated camera motion that obscures technical cutaways or captions
Break sensor/focal-length consistency between Blender and Three.js shots

specialists.mission: Configure particles, dust, smoke, fog, rain, sparks, glow, atmosphere, and color-coded 3D airflow/thermal vectors without obstructing scene or caption readability.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Applies audited particle and ACESFilmic grading presets within mobile/cloud budgets.

forbidden_actions: Occlude lower-third safe-area captions or primary mechanism cutaways with dense particles
Use non-seeded particle emitters that vary across re-renders

specialists.mission: Plan narration voice settings, character dialogue delivery, ~130-160 WPM Indonesian pacing estimates pre-approval, BGM/ambience/foley/SFX cues, -15 LUFS mastering, and post-approval WAV alignment.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Deterministic speech duration estimation before approval and exact WAV sync post-approval.

forbidden_actions: Clone voices from reference videos without explicit authorization
Trigger paid TTS synthesis before human approval (or separate preview approval)
Time-compress speech unnaturally instead of revising overly long narration

specialists.mission: Generate classic bold, word-highlight, karaoke, phrase, kinetic, scientific-label, numeric-callout, and speaker-ID captions inside safe areas synced to verified audio/ASR timestamps.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Safe-area geometry enforcement and honest separation of pre-approval estimates vs ASR alignment.

forbidden_actions: Claim uniform word-duration estimates are verified forced-aligned ASR
Place captions outside vertical 9:16 safe zones or over critical visual labels

specialists.mission: Audit pre-production packages in a separate fresh context across topic fit, fact citations, script originality, hook strength, clause-to-shot alignment, character/asset completeness, and engine compatibility.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Independent fresh-context critique prevents producer confirmation bias.

forbidden_actions: Silently edit, patch, or overwrite any producer artifact
Approve packages containing placeholder scripts, unverified factual claims, or >10s unapproved shots

specialists.mission: Inspect actual rendered frames, contact sheets, and temporal motion via REA-Video for character continuity, foot sliding, mesh penetration, hand-prop contact, lighting, readability, and narrative relevance.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Requires genuine multimodal visual inspection citing exact shot_id, timestamp, or frame.

forbidden_actions: Judge visual quality from JSON manifests alone without inspecting actual rendered frames
Mutate scene or render files directly instead of emitting shot-referenced defects

specialists.mission: Deterministically verify file integrity, full FFmpeg video decode, resolution, FPS, frame count, duration, audio sync, zero timeline gaps/overlaps, asset provenance, and SHA-256 approval digests.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Executes deterministic CLI/Python checks (ffprobe, ffmpeg -f null, approval_gate, pytest).

forbidden_actions: Modify source code, tests, or approval records to mask technical failures
Skip full stream decode verification on rendered media

specialists.mission: Render the final evidence-based PASS/REVISION_REQUIRED verdict across Preproduction Verifier, Technical Auditor, and Visual Critic reports against explicit milestone acceptance criteria.

preferred_model_routing.rationale: Final adversarial gatekeeper preventing premature victory claims.

forbidden_actions: Grant final production PASS based solely on unit tests, schema validation, or self-tests
Lower acceptance criteria or silently waive unresolved defects
